Dental Implants

Missing teeth? Let us help. Dental implants at ZDentistry provide a permanent, natural-looking solution for replacing missing teeth and restoring your smile and function.

Book Appointment Call: +91 89844 89929

Restore Your Smile with Dental Implants

Dental implants are the gold standard for replacing missing teeth. At ZDentistry, Dr. Zuben’s expertise in oral and maxillofacial surgery ensures you receive the highest quality implant care.

Why Choose Dental Implants?

Natural Look and Feel Implants are designed to look, feel, and function like your natural teeth. Most people can’t tell the difference.

Preserve Bone and Facial Structure Unlike dentures, implants stimulate the jawbone, preventing the bone loss that occurs when teeth are missing.

Long-Lasting Solution With proper care, implants can last a lifetime, making them a cost-effective long-term solution.

Protect Adjacent Teeth Unlike bridges, implants don’t require grinding down neighboring healthy teeth.

The Implant Process

1. Consultation and Planning We evaluate your oral health, take detailed scans, and create a personalized treatment plan.

2. Implant Placement A titanium post is surgically placed into the jawbone. This serves as the root of your new tooth.

3. Healing Period Over 3-6 months, the implant fuses with your bone in a process called osseointegration.

4. Abutment Placement Once healed, a connector piece (abutment) is attached to the implant.

5. Crown Placement Finally, a custom-made crown is attached, completing your new tooth.

Types of Implant Solutions

  • Single Tooth Implants: Replace one missing tooth
  • Implant-Supported Bridges: Replace multiple adjacent teeth
  • Implant-Supported Dentures: Secure full arch of teeth
  • All-on-4: Full arch restoration with just four implants

Advanced Implant Services

As a maxillofacial surgeon, Dr. Zuben can handle complex cases that other dentists may not be able to, including:

  • Bone grafting for patients with bone loss
  • Sinus lift procedures
  • Immediate implant placement
  • Complex full-mouth rehabilitation

Schedule Your Implant Consultation

Ready to restore your smile with dental implants? Contact ZDentistry to schedule your consultation and learn how implants can transform your life.

Frequently Asked Questions

Am I a candidate for dental implants?

Most adults with good general health are candidates. Factors include adequate bone density, healthy gums, and commitment to oral hygiene. We'll evaluate your specific situation during consultation.

How long do dental implants last?

With proper care, dental implants can last a lifetime. The crown on top may need replacement after 10-15 years due to normal wear.

Is the implant procedure painful?

The procedure is performed under local anesthesia, so you won't feel pain during surgery. Post-operative discomfort is usually mild and manageable with over-the-counter pain medication.

How long does the implant process take?

The total process typically takes 3-6 months to allow for healing and osseointegration (bone fusing with the implant). Some cases may qualify for immediate implants.
